Reviewer point (plain language): Repost cascades are reconstructed, not observed. The similarity between platforms could be an artifact of the reconstruction method. Validate it or drop reposts.
How we address it: We rebuilt every repost cascade under 5 alternative linking rules plus a 40-draw random rule ensemble, on the full data (244k cascades, 4M reposts). The platform difference stays near zero (within +/-0.03) under every rule, while the reply difference is 5 to 8 times larger. So the finding is not an artifact. We will also rename these cascades 'reconstructed' and align the code with the rule described in the appendix.
Status (Aug 17): Analysis complete; results and draft figure ready
Remaining effort: Write the new appendix section and add the figure
